# stat_sacf {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
stat_sacf(data, d1, d2)
stat_sacf(data, lam, d1, d2)
```
Compute the spatial autocorrelation function (SACF) statistic at lag `(d1, d2)`.
 
The first method takes a single image (matrix), centers it and returns the spatial autocorrelation as a `Float64`.
 
The second method takes a sequence of images (3-dimensional array, third dimension = time), applies EWMA smoothing with parameter `lam` and returns the vector of sequentially computed EWMA statistics, one per image.
 
  * `data`: data matrix (single image) or 3-dimensional array (image sequence).
  * `lam`: smoothing parameter of the EWMA statistic (second method only).
  * `d1::Int`: row delay.
  * `d2::Int`: column delay.
The asymptotic critical value is provided by [`crit_val_sacf`](crit_val_sacf.qmd).
 


:::
